Eruption allows the user to burn their fat to produce a lava-like substance, that's as hot as magma, and eject it from their body.

With the modifications of his suit, Maguma's right hand can scatter wide-range magma, while his left hand extrudes lava lasers.

Explosion allows the user to excrete nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignite it at will to create explosions of various sizes.

Through either one of his palms, Katsuki creates fiery shock waves that are highly powerful and destructive, often burning and/or shattering whatever they hit, with Katsuki himself being immune to them, save for some minor damage from the recoil. Because this Quirk generates light, it's a natural counter to Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow, which thrives in the dark.

The more Katsuki sweats, the more powerful the explosions become. This essentially means that Katsuki's blast gradually grows in power the longer he fights, since he will naturally sweat more through ongoing physical activity.
descricaoPt:
A explosão permite que o usuário excrete suor semelhante à nitroglicerina das palmas das mãos e o incendeie à vontade para criar explosões de vários tamanhos.

Através de uma das palmas, Katsuki cria ondas de choque flamejantes que são altamente poderosas e destrutivas, frequentemente queimando e/ou despedaçando tudo o que atingem, sendo Katsuki ele próprio imune a elas, exceto por algum dano menor causado pelo recuo. Como essa Quirk gera luz, ela é um contra‑ataque natural à Sombra Sombria de Fumikage Tokoyami, que prospera na escuridão.

Quanto mais Katsuki sua, mais poderosas se tornam as explosões. Isso significa essencialmente que a explosão de Katsuki aumenta gradualmente em potência quanto mais tempo ele luta, já que ele naturalmente suará mais com a atividade física contínua.

descricao:
While using this Quirk, the user can manipulate the growth and movements of all of their hair. Their hair is unusually resilient and indestructible, making it impervious to any harm or damage.

Nagamasa's Quirk is very powerful as it allows him to create an armor around his body and incapacitate a large number of enemies at once by capturing them within his extended hair.

The hair is prone to get tangled, which can be annoying for him. It is unknown if Nagamasa's usual hairy appearance is a result of his Quirk being activated or if it is his natural look.
was the Meta Ability used by Bruce Lee and later inherited by Izuku Midoriya, before forcibly transferring it via blood transference to Tomura Shigaraki.
Fan allows the user to create wind or even tornadoes by spinning their wrists.

The user of Fast Fist can move at least their hands extremely quickly, allowing them to hit up to 100 times in less than a second.

Using the Quirk, Blackbelt is able to repeatedly hit near someone's pressure point, eventually hitting it and instantly knocking them unconscious; due to the speed of Fast Fist, it moves fast enough that to the naked eye, it seems like a single chop motion.

Fat Absorption grants the user the ability to adhere any objects to their body and make them sink into their body fat upon contact with it.

This Quirk provides a high degree of protection, making Taishiro very resistant to blades, bullets, and attack-heavy Quirks. Those who attempt to physically strike him may end up getting stuck to his body, allowing Taishiro the opportunity to restrain them.

Fat Absorption also lets Taishiro absorb the raw force behind enemy attacks and then release it back in a singular counterattacking punch; however, utilizing this technique requires him to burn down his fat as he stockpiles said force, weakening his defense in the process and leaving him practically powerless if the counterattack doesn't bring down the target.

Fiber Master allows the user to freely control fiber.

Tsunagu has power over all types of cloth, being capable of telekinetic dominance over the threads that compose them. Targets are unable to resist its power as long as they are wearing clothes (although strong enough foes, such as All For One, can still react against it). Denim is the easiest textile to manipulate, while sweats are the hardest.

Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers.

Fierce Gains allows the user's muscles to harden at exceptionally tough levels.

Gigantomachia uses this Quirk in conjunction with his make-shift body granted by Mole, and his ability to not feel pain to make his skin nearly unable to be pierced by anything.
was the Quirk used by Keigo Takami, until it was stolen from him by All For One.

The Quirk allows the user the ability to rip off chunks of their hair and explode them like firecrackers. The blasts are strong enough to destroy buildings.

The Bomb Villain can utilize the firecrackers to propel himself forward, similar to how Katsuki Bakugo uses his Explosion Quirk, however much weaker in comparison.

Flash Bang Sweat allows the user to sweat a substance that produces a bright light and sound on impact.

Dadan's hero costume can launch missiles that are filled with his Quirk. Romero Fujimi commented that this Quirk would be better if it could hurt people. It's unknown if this Quirk is the reason Dadan sweats all the time. Using his costume's missiles, Dadan is able to fire a salvo over a wide area, producing a sound loud enough to be heard by those far away from the impact.
Flight is the Quirk used by Christopher Skyline. A variant of it is also possessed by the Bombers.
was the Quirk used by Nana Shimura and later inherited by Izuku Midoriya, before forcibly transferring it via blood transference to Tomura Shigaraki.

Fly Swatter allows the user to send energy waves and attack from a farther distance than their normal reach.

In order to use the Quirk, Shoko appears to have to swing one of her arms very quickly, in which she could use it multiple times at once.

The farthest distance that Shoko has been able to use her Quirk is only a few meters away from her. The force of these energy waves seem to be about the same as if a regular person were to do the same action at a closer distance. It is unknown if she could swat any farther than that.

The Quirk allows the user to glide through the air like a flying squirrel, with wing-like films on her arms.

Clair's sidekick has enough power to carry the weight of one person on her back during flight.

She primarily uses her Quirk to support Clair, allowing her to fly into battle when infiltrating enemy territory.

Foldabody grants the user the ability to manipulate the thinness of their body as well as stretch their limbs.

Shinya can make his body completely flat and fold it into different forms. This allows him to pass through narrow spaces and move quickly while remaining undetected. He can shift his body into multiple shapes in an instant, giving him enhanced mobility, striking precision, and flexibility.

Food allows the user to bite, chew, and digest anything that they are able to come into direct contact with.

Soramitsu is able to chew through objects with ease, and his targets do not seem to put up much resistance, whatsoever.

When the Quirk is used, it does not appear to make the user feel filled up at all and has been referred to as bottomless.

Forced Quirk Activation allows the user to forcefully activate someone's Quirk against their will. Whether the target is conscious or not, the Quirk will work without fail, thus giving the user a method to use their allies' Quirks without having to worry about their state. They are also able to use it on themselves, even if their body is paralyzed in some way, though this is only useful if the user possesses an additional Quirk to activate.

On two occasions that All For One has used this Quirk, it has been in combination with the Rivet Stab to create contact with his target before activating the Quirk.

Foresight granted the user the ability to accurately predict all of the target's future moves and actions for an entire hour.

Foresight activated by first touching a target and then making eye contact with them. Once these conditions had been met, Mirai was capable of watching the target's future lifetime from a third-person perspective that showcased the target themselves and their immediate surroundings, in a manner similar to a flashback. Mirai did not appear to have a limit to how far he was able to see into the future, being capable of foreseeing events that were years beyond present time.
It is unknown what this Quirk can do, but based on the name, it can be presumed it allows the user's legs to move freely without tiring out.

Frog is the summation of Tsuyu's many frog-related abilities. This includes frog-like anatomy, great leg strength, wall clinging, a powerful extending tongue, camouflaging, fast swimming, regurgitation control, and secreting mucus with different effects like paralysis and hiding scent. Tsuyu is seemingly capable of using all those skills limitlessly and in combination with one another. She also appears to have access to all abilities used by frogs, regardless of what species they belong to.

As part of her training, Tsuyu worked out all the muscles in her body, including her tongue, by rock climbing on the side of a cliff while having her elongated tongue remain in place at the top of the structure.

Frost gives the user the capability of manipulating and producing ice around their body, being able to coat themselves in ice and blast it out.

Rei's possession of this Quirk was what directly resulted in her Quirk Marriage with Enji Todoroki to create a child that possessed a perfect fusion of it and his Hellflame Quirk. The second and third children, Fuyumi and Natsuo, inherited the Frost Quirk. The eldest, Toya, inherited a stronger version of Hellflame, but Frost's resistance to ice and not enough resistance to fire to properly use his Quirk. Toya later manifested ice as part of his Quirk after coming close to death. The youngest son, Shoto eventually developed the combination Quirk that Enji so desired, Half-Cold Half-Hot, containing the strength of both Quirks as well as the way to alleviate their respective weaknesses.

Gale Gale gives the user the ability to manipulate wind and whirl it around their body to fly.

While the Gale Villain looks relatively harmless, his body surrounded by the powerful blasts of wind is strong enough to deflect anything that comes into contact with.

Gas grants the user the ability to generate a poisonous, sleep-inducing gas from their body.

The user is capable of producing a large amount of purple-colored gas, enough to completely fill The Beast's Forest. Anyone who inhales the gas directly will immediately fall asleep and remain that way until the toxin is treated.

The presence and movement speed of anyone within the gas can be sensed by the user thanks to its fluctuations. The gas' concentration is highest at its center and loses potency in lesser affected areas away from the user. The gas swirls in a typhoon, completely centered around the user. Navigating through the gas is also very difficult, similar to a very thick fog.

Gatling grants the user gun-like organs in their arms.

Gunhead can shoot claw-like objects made out of keratin from his gun-like organs. The Quirk is very useful in close quarters combat and he mainly uses it for suppressive fire.
was the Meta Ability used by Toshitsugu Kudo and later inherited by Izuku Midoriya, before forcibly transferring it via blood transference to Tomura Shigaraki.

Gecko grants the user a reptilian appearance and the ability to cling onto walls and other sheer surfaces.

Gecko appears to have strong adherence power, since Shuichi can remain attached even to fast-moving vehicles.

Gecko is noted to be a rather weak and unimpressive Quirk, even among Shuichi's reptilian family.

Shuichi uses this primarily in urban areas, where walls are plentiful.

This Quirk presumably grants the user flying turtle-based powers. However, due to the way that it is shown, it is inconclusive as to whether or not Eiji will always be spinning, or giant. This is because the true abilities of this Quirk are unknown, as it is only shown while Eiji is under the influence of Trigger.
is the Quirk used by Yu Takeyama, Gigantomachia, Enigma, and the unnamed Giant Villain.

This Quirk allows the user to create both visual and auditory illusions for a short period of time.

Camie emits a mist-like substance from her mouth which forms the illusion. Said illusions can reach an impressive scale, enough to fill a large room.

The illusions eventually dissipate although it's unknown if this is voluntary on Camie's part.

Glide and Slide allows its users to glide along the ground as though they had roller skates on. When using this Quirk, the users appear to make gestures that would be akin to a roller skater in order to pick up momentum. This ability gives them enhanced speed, which makes them far quicker than the average person. It is unknown what their top speed is. However, they seem to be slower than Koichi Haimawari's Slide and Glide Quirk, as he was able to very quickly catch up and overtake them.

This Quirk is similar to Slide and Glide, except it only seems to require the users to have one of their feet on whatever surface they are travelling across.

The Quirk allows the user to produce a smooth liquid from their skin.

Its moisturizing effect gives Mitsuki a flawless skin quality which maintains her youthful appearance, despite her age.

When genetically combined with her husband's Quirk, it results in an Explosion Quirk, which is used by their son.

Good Ear allows the user to hear high frequencies that humans normally cannot. Sirius uses it to communicate with Selkie when they are far apart. She can also use it to detect the number of people nearby.

Grasshopper allows the user the ability to transform into a large humanoid grasshopper, increasing their physical capabilities.

However, the Hotta Brothers have only been seen using this Quirk after injecting doses of unadulterated Trigger, so the Quirk's true capabilities are unknown.

Gyrate allows the user to rotate any part of their body at high speeds.

The effects of Gyrate turn Sen's limbs into something akin to a drill. This enhances his hand-to-hand combat capabilities significantly.

Hair Control allows its user to manipulate their hair in various ways. 

Needle Hair is able to fire off strands of her hair like bullets. Martial Hair can only control her ponytails, which she can use to form weapons to attack her enemies.

Hair-Raiser makes the user capable of extending and hardening hair strands that they can tear off from their own head. Mr. Brave can freely shape-shift his hair strands into versatile, functional weapons or tools this way.

Half-Cold Half-Hot allows the user to generate ice, frost, and cold from the right side of their body, and fire, flames, and heat from the left. However, the user is unable to manipulate either element that comes from an external source; they can only create them from their body.

The Quirk's power is perfectly divided between the right and left sides of the user's body. This gives the user two powerful, separate methods of combat that they may use regardless of the other.

Half-Cold Half-Hot stems from the fusion of the Hellflame Quirk of Shoto's father, Enji Todoroki, and the Frost Quirk from his mother, Rei Todoroki, through a Quirk Marriage.

As part of his training, Shoto submerged himself in a barrel of water and alternated between his ice and fire abilities to regulate the temperature of the water.

Hardening gives the user the power to harden any part of their body. The Quirk protects them from most physical threats.

Once activated, Eijiro becomes capable of enduring what would be otherwise lethal hazards, like tons of falling metal and multiple explosions, without leaving a scratch. Even bullets are unable to pierce his skin.

Aside from increased defense, Hardening also grants Eijiro offensive power by turning his hardened body rough and sharp like rock, increasing his physical strength and allowing him to cut enemies by grazing them. This all leads to Hardening being a highly practical Quirk for hero work, which is frequently combat-oriented.

Hardening has often been compared to Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's Steel Quirk due to their similar functions of increasing durability.
descricaoPt:
Hardening dá ao usuário o poder de endurecer qualquer parte de seu corpo. O Quirk o protege da maioria das ameaças físicas.

Uma vez ativado, Eijiro se torna capaz de suportar perigos que seriam letais, como toneladas de metal caindo e múltiplas explosões, sem deixar um arranhão. Até balas são incapazes de perfurar sua pele.

Além da defesa aumentada, Hardening também concede a Eijiro poder ofensivo ao transformar seu corpo endurecido em algo áspero e afiado como pedra, aumentando sua força física e permitindo que ele corte inimigos ao roçá‑los. Tudo isso faz de Hardening um Quirk altamente prático para o trabalho de herói, que costuma ser orientado ao combate.

Hardening costuma ser comparado ao Quirk de Aço de Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu devido às funções semelhantes de aumento de durabilidade.

descricao:
Hardflame Fan allows the user to generate a wall, or layers of walls, of fire which they can use to cover a part of their body for defense.

In the anime, this appears to be a shiny green liquid they generate.

Heal allows the user to amplify and quicken their target's natural healing process by extending their lips and kissing them. The user can also choose how much they can heal the receiver in order to not drain too much stamina from them.

With Heal, some grave injuries requiring months to heal can be healed completely in a matter of seconds.
Heavy Payload seemingly increases the damage output of the user's attacks.

Helical Scythe grants the user large, red appendages on their fingers and head, which they are able to extend and manipulate like tendrils. These appendages are strong enough to pierce through solid ice and can be used individually to ensnare opponents and/or attack them from a distance.

This Quirk also allows Leviathan to rotate his tendrils to manipulate elements, such as changing the flow of water to create a typhoon-like plume that he is able freely maneuver himself in. His Quirk can also affect fire, and allows him to create a large construct of himself.

Leviathan is only seen using this Quirk while under the effects of Trigger. It is unknown how the Quirk functions without the aid of the Quirk-enhancing drugs.

Hellflame is an extremely powerful Quirk that gives the user fire-based abilities. 

Enji can generate large fire blasts to incinerate his opponents and cover his body in flames. He can control the temperature of his flames to increase or decrease their destructive output, and he can even heat them up to the point of turning them blue, similar to his son Toya's own Quirk, Blueflame.

Shoto Todoroki inherited this Quirk as the left side of his Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk, while Toya inherited a more powerful version of Hellflame known as Blueflame, which, while stronger, is also dangerously taxing on Toya's heat sensitive body due to him inheriting his mother's cold tolerance rather than his father's high-temperature endurance.

High Specs grants the user unparalleled intelligence, perception, reactions and comprehension that far surpasses that of any human. Through this Quirk, Nezu, an animal, is capable of thinking, speaking, and acting like a human. Additionally, Nezu has evolved beyond a normal rat, becoming physically stronger, more dexterous, and even taller as a result of High Specs.

Due to his unfathomable intelligence, Nezu is capable of instantly formulating incredibly intricate strategies. For example, from a single vantage point, he can create a chain reaction of destruction to wreck an entire industrial zone with just one well-placed wrecking ball smash. This same intellect also grants him flawless leadership skills, which are acknowledged by the fact that he is the principal of U.A. High School, the top hero school in Japan.

Because of his intelligence, Nezu can perfectly recall anything.

The Quirk allows the user to create holograms of anything they wish, with the largest ones being able to be spotted from a great distance away.

Mahoro uses her Quirk to stage pranks, scare off attackers, or to send a signal in case of an emergency.

The holograms have no effect on the world around them, which includes them not possessing shadows. They can disappear by being blown away by force, or if Mahoro loses her focus.
Homing allows the user to lock on to any target that they can see within six hundred meters of themselves and make any projectile they release chase after said target.

Horn Cannon allows the user to detach and launch their horns as projectiles.

Pony can fire off several horns in succession, with a new set regenerating on her head almost instantly. She possesses the ability to remotely control up to four of them as well, allowing her to change their mid-air trajectory to get around obstacles. Those horns are strong enough to restrain Mezo Shoji, who is known for his high physical strength, and thrust away Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, who can turn his body into metal. Her horns can carry multiple people and objects, although doing so slows their usual speed significantly.
After raising their arm, the user can generate a large hoop of energy that they can throw at their opponent to attack them.

Hydra allowed the user to summon gigantic, serpentine shark-like creatures from their back that they can control at will. The creatures are large enough to crush a person in their jaws.

Nine usually summons one single snake, although the creature can split in two when attacked. When the Quirk is boosted by an enhancer drug, Nine can summon multiple snake heads.

Nine generally reserves this power to surprise enemies who attack him from behind. He can also use two of them to lift himself in the air.

The Quirk allows the user to enlarge their arm at will to enormous sizes. The etymology and medical definition of the word "hypertrophy" also suggest this to be the Quirk's effect.

All For One has used this Quirk in combination with several of his other Quirks for a deadly attack, as well as greatly strengthening his arm to restrain Hood, or deliver a crushing blow to All Might through a wall. He also used the Quirk alongside Accelerator Rings to deliver a swift backhand strike against All Might.

Ice Ply allows the user to freely manipulate any and all nearby ice. They can freely gather, move, attack with, and defend with the ice they control. The known range of Geten's power extends to the size of an entire town.

After undergoing an Awakening, Geten learned that he could also manipulate the temperature of ice, thus allowing him to freeze water into ice and giving him more ice to control.

Ignition grants the user fire abilities, generating a small flame from the top of their head. Moyuru is able to exhale powerful flares through his mouth.

Under the effects of Trigger, the flames appear all across his upper body, and his fire becomes more powerful.
Impact Recoil allows the user to reverse the impact caused by an opposing physical force, damaging the opposition instead.
is a Quirk used by All For One, who stole it from an unknown user. It was also used by Tomura Shigaraki.

Incite lines the user's voice with an electromagnetic pulse. If someone who considers the Meta Ability user a worthy leader hears the user's voice, then their physical and mental state will be significantly enhanced. The louder the user's voice is, the more effective the Meta Ability becomes.

Hence the name, this Quirk gives the user infrared senses, to the point where they can sense their entire surroundings by using those senses. This Quirk was never seen in action, but it can be possible that the user has been granted infrared vision similar to snakes.

All For One uses this Quirk to compensate for his blindness and to be able to easily navigate around his surroundings. This Quirk also allows him to sense the emotional state of others to an extent.

Invisibility causes the user to unconsciously refract the light that hits them, granting them a completely invisible body.

Because of Invisibility, none of Toru's physical features can be observed through the naked eye, making it hard to detect her presence or read her emotions unless she announces them herself.

This Quirk involves a degree of light manipulation due to its nature, and with training Toru gained the ability to refract light from her prism-like, invisible body through conscious use of that manipulation. In ordinary circumstances, this refracted light is no more deadly than normal light, with its primary function being to blind opponents. But when used on a form of light that can already inflict harm, such as Navel Laser, it will retain its destructive power after being refracted, allowing the attack to be redirected or focused.

IQ allows the user to enhance their intellect by multiplying their IQ, and become a super-genius temporarily after consuming tea and closing their eyes to think.

With this intellect, and the knowledge she already knows, Saiko is able to develop complex plans and outsmart her opponents. It is told, but not shown, that different types of tea will have different effects on her. While closing her eyes and using this Quirk, bright yellow visualizations of the equations she runs in her head appear and circle around her, accompanied by orange, electronic circuit diagrams.

The Quirk gives the user the ability to produce and shoot iron balls from their knuckles.

Sidero has a fair amount of control over the mass of the iron balls, ranging in size from an egg to bigger than his body.

The Quirk turns the end of the user's fingers into metallic claws.

Higari's Quirk lets him use his claws to burrow himself underground, like a mole, while Sickle Claw's manifestation made his hands into larger, sharper claws, which he uses to slash his opponents.

The Quirk gives the user the ability to turn their arms into iron clubs. The iron clubs are covered with spikes and have the power to crush boulders.

The transformation gives Rogone an ogre-like appearance and enlarges his height to 229cm.

Jet grants the user the ability to expel air from open holes on the soles of their feet. This allows them to fly around a limited range as well as move faster than the eye can follow, even on the ground.

The air used to fuel Jet is taken from the breath of the user. Jets on the user's feet propel them in a straight line to their desired destination. Switching angles require a second breath to create another pulse of air. Momentum granted from this power can be used to improve the user's own strength.

Jet provides its user with the ability to fly to a certain degree and it also serves as a great evasion ability.

Kaiju is only seen while Ryuichi is on Trigger, so its normal effects are unknown. What has been shown is that this Quirk allows Ryuichi to turn into a massive dinosaur-like beast resembling Godzilla, with Kuin Hachisuka comparing it to Gigantification in that regard.

This Quirk seemingly increases the amount of kinetic energy the user creates and releases.

All For One possesses four copies of this Quirk, significantly increasing its effects.
, also known as '''King's Ram''', is the Quirk used by an unnamed student from Masegaki Primary School.
Landmine allowed the user to bestow explosive properties on anything they touched. The explosions could be detonated at will.

Larceny allows the user to take any object that their target possesses, instantly bringing it into their hands.

The objects that can be "stolen" include even manifestations created from other Quirks. Because of Larceny, Toya has a natural advantage against weapon users, such as armed policemen.
Laser allowed the user to fire energy beams from their right eye.

Leafipulation allows its user to manipulate leaves from the plant life around them, and fire them off as projectiles toward the user's opponents.

While it is unknown how strong this Quirk is, it has multiple apparent disadvantages, such as that the user does not seem to be able to generate leaves from their body and must rely on leaves from pre-existing sources. This would make the Quirk useless in most urban environments, such as cities, that do not have many trees or plants nearby.

Leap allows the user to leap at very high and large distances. This Quirk is not related to flight, so the user needs a foothold to jump off of. When activated, the Quirk lets the user leap high, and fall without taking any damage, meaning that the Quirk acts as a cushion when activated.

Life Force doubles the user's life span, causing them to age at a slower rate and making them look much younger than they really are. This is why Kyudai looks as if he's only in his sixties when he really is at least 120 years old. If the Quirk is cancelled, the user rapidly ages into a much more decrepit shape.

At some point, Kyudai duplicated his Life Force and gave the original version of the Quirk to All For One while keeping the duplicate to himself.
