This Quirk allows the user to utilize the power and speed of a lion. 

Through these attributes, the user can even let out a powerful roar that can negate Orcinus's hypersonic paralysis waves.

Lizard grants the user a reptilian appearance, with a tail, a tongue with two tines, and a body covered in scales. Not much is known about the extent of the abilities the Quirk provides, other than it grants Rapt enhanced endurance and a better healing factor.

Under Trigger's effects, he becomes more lizard-like and his arms turn into pterosaur-like wings that allow him to fly.

Lizard Tail Splitter allows the user to split their body into several pieces and control them telekinetically.

Setsuna is able to split off pieces from any part of her body. Those cutoff bits of hers move around by floating, following Setsuna's will. Due to their usually small size and high speed of movement, they're hard targets to hit individually.

Notably, if any of those pieces contain a functioning organ, said organ is capable of operating by itself away from the rest of her body, allowing Setsuna to, for example, speak with just a floating jaw that contains her mouth, or see with just one quarter of her face, as long as it has one of her eyes on it.

Lock Down allows the user to lock objects into a particular point of space, turning the touched object effectively immobile.

Rock Lock activates this Quirk through protrusions on his fingers that resemble key teeth. The Quirk is useful for stopping moving terrain, at least to a certain point.

The Quirk allows the user to transform their left hand's thumb and pinky finger into a bow, with which they can use to shoot anything with absolute control.

Beros imbues enough power within her arrows to easily penetrate vehicles, and they can navigate through the air to chase opponents.

Love allows the user to power up a target by confessing their feelings for them.

The more intense the user's love is, the stronger the power transmitted to the target is. This empowering makes the target physically stronger and faster than usual. Manami and Danjuro Tobita refer to this empowered state as "Lover Mode". Heart-shaped smoke appears around the body of the target when "Lover Mode" is active.

Manami also doesn't need to be within a certain range for the Quirk to go into effect, as Danjuro was able to enter Lover Mode upon just hearing her voice through a comms link, even while on opposite sides of the country.
Luminescence was the unnamed Meta Ability used by the Luminescent Baby, until it was stolen from them by All For One.

Mad Gluttony allows the user to devour objects using the giant mouth in their stomach, with it being able to quickly inhale, crunch, and destroy whatever is in their path.

When enhanced by Overmodification, Ginji is able to sprout mouths from anywhere on his body, which he can use as tendrils to attack and bite others from a distance.
Magic allowed the user to create rings out of energy from their wrist to move people or objects. Once within the ring, he could manipulate the speed of it at will.

Magnetism allowed the user to magnetize people around them, up to a 4.5-meter radius of themselves at will.

Kenji can magnetize a person's entire body or specific portions. Once magnetized, the targets either attract or repel each other, depending on whether they are of the same sex or not. Men are polarized south and women are polarized north, which is represented in the anime through a blue and a red aura, respectively.

Manifest grants the user the ability to enhance their body parts with the characteristics of anything they consume.

Tamaki can manifest certain traits of any food he's eaten while it's still active within his digestive system. For example, if he eats Takoyaki, he can transform his fingers into octopus tentacles and if he eats a clam, he can harden his hands into a clam shell, etc. Multiple simultaneous manifestations of different foods are also possible.

The more of a substance is eaten, the stronger the manifestation will be; this Quirk technically has no upper limit to its potential.

Although they usually are, items consumed do not necessarily have to be food, as anything Tamaki's body is capable of consuming will work with his Quirk, such as Yu Hojo's crystals.

Manifestation occurs only on command and any trait can be dismissed at will.
This Quirk presumably grants the user mantis-based powers and abilities, judging by how Kirihito seemed to handle using his Quirk when under the effects of Trigger.

Meatball grants the user the ability to manipulate raw human flesh.

The user can manipulate their own flesh, giving them the ability to separate their limbs and control them at will.

Flesh can be expanded and molded together for offensive and defensive maneuvers. It can be levitated and used as projectiles to capture targets.

Anyone captured by a ball of flesh can be kneaded and rolled into a meatball, rendering them immobile and disfigured. People who have been turned into balls of flesh still maintain all their senses. Seiji must maintain focus to keep their targets restricted, and this hold can be released if the user takes enough physical damage.

Metal Manipulation grants the user the ability to control pre-existing metallic material.

By just placing his hand on any metallic surface, Wolfram can manipulate any given object in the room to create different types of structures to attack and/or defend.

With the ability to bend any metal to their will, the user is capable of freely bending and changing the shape of any metal material they wish. This gives Wolfram a major advantage when fighting in areas filled with a lot of metal objects.

Inversely, Wolfram holds little fighting ability on settings where metal is rare or nonexistent. This Quirk is also inefficient for fighting at close range. 

When the user touches metal to activate their Quirk, their hand (or hands) glows with a bright blue electrical discharge of energy.
Mimicry allows the user to transfer their own body and mind into solid objects, and manipulate them as though the object was their actual body.
Once the user touches a person, their Quirk will force the person to expose things they don't want others to know or embarrassing things about their past that they want to hide.
is one of the several Quirks utilized by Gigantomachia, that was given to him by All For One, who stole it from an unknown person.

Monster Cat allows the user to merge with an object or machinery, assume its shape, and control it completely. It can also be defused from said object.

Monster Cat was only seen in operation after Kuin Hachisuka injected a bit of Trigger into the animal, boosting his Quirk and allowing him to take over a bus. The capacity of Monster Cat under normal circumstances is unknown.

The Quirk allows the user to create various monsters, similar to those found in a dungeon-crawler video game. They all appear to share a similar blob shape, eye-less with a large mouth, with the designs ranging from being more bulky, possessing multiple heads, featuring wings, and more. Some of these monsters resemble wyverns, dinosaurs, and giant frogs. It is unknown how this Quirk works and how it creates monsters, though it could possibly be a magical-based ability.

When strengthened by Overmodification, Simon is capable of producing a near endless amount of them.
Muddied grants the user the ability to cause minor amnesia to a person if they make contact with their head, making their memories of the previous five minutes and the next five minutes vague.
Although never properly described, the Quirk seemingly allows the user to grow multiple arms from their body.

Mummification allows the user to manipulate the red bandages they are wrapped in to ensnare inanimate objects that get caught in them and turning them into humanoid red mummies that they can control at will and make them fight for them. Although the limit number is unknown, Hoyo can control dozens of mummies at the same time.

His Quirk only works on inanimate objects, so he cannot control living beings directly, but he still can indirectly control them by manipulating clothing and objects that people may possess with his bandages, and in this way, use them to attack and provide himself with human shields.
is the Quirk used by Goto Imasuji, as well as possessed by All For One, who stole it from an unknown person, and later used by the Four Eyed Nomu, Wolfram, and Hood.
Muscle Expansion allows the user to expand and strengthen their muscles, granting them a significant increase in physical strength.

Mushroom allows the user to generate and spread fungus spores from their body.

Once these spores make contact with a solid surface, they will quickly grow into full-grown mushrooms. The spores can grow from any surface, be it the area, the user's own body, and even other people's bodies. The spores spread easier in an area with high humidity.
Mutant Bovini allows its user to fire off lasers from their face and causes the user to take on a bovine-like appearance.
Navel Laser is the Quirk used by Yuga Aoyama, which was given to him by All For One, who had originally stolen it from someone else.

Neutralization allows the user to temporarily nullify a target's Quirk by touching them, which is activated from the right arm of the user. The activation of this Quirk is shown when the palm of the user's right hand glows a bright light blue. The more powerful a Quirk is, the longer and brighter the light is emitted from the user's hand.

While its abilities are not great for combat purposes, this Quirk is effective more towards treating Quirks with terrible effects on their user's, such as Overmodification. Thanks to Neutralization, Anna Scervino's seizures were mitigated and she was able to live a somewhat normal life.

Neutralization does not seem to be restricted to skin contact, as Giulio is seen wearing a glove on his right hand while using it.

After Overmodification went out of control, it managed to modify Neutralization's capabilities.
was the Quirk used by Star and Stripe, until it was stolen from her by Tomura Shigaraki. It is now possessed by neither, following its self-destruction.
Octopus provides the user with the physiology and skills of an octopus, such as multiple elastic appendages, suckers and the ability to spit ink from their siphon-like mouth.

Octopus (Squid) gives the user the same number of limbs as a cephalopod creature, making them appear like a humanoid octopus or squid.

The Quirk grants Ikajiro with six arms, along with two extra tentacle-like arms that remain hidden in the torso and can be used to perform surprise attacks.

One For All was the transferable Quirk that was possessed by its ninth user, Izuku Midoriya.

In the past, it was originally used by Yoichi Shigaraki, and later, its other previous hosts: Toshitsugu Kudo, Bruce Lee, Hikage Shinomori, Daigoro Banjo, En Tayutai, Nana Shimura, and Toshinori Yagi. Izuku forcibly transferred the Quirk to Tomura Shigaraki via blood transference, and as a result, the Quirk was destroyed and became unusable. It was also briefly used by Katsuki Bakugo.
descricaoPt: One For All era a Quirk transferível que era possuída por seu nono usuário, Izuku Midoriya. No passado, ela foi originalmente usada por Yoichi Shigaraki e, posteriormente, por seus outros hospedeiros anteriores: Toshitsugu Kudo, Bruce Lee, Hikage Shinomori, Daigoro Banjo, En Tayutai, Nana Shimura e Toshinori Yagi. Izuku transferiu a Quirk à força para Tomura Shigaraki por meio de transferência de sangue e, como resultado, a Quirk foi destruída e se tornou inutilizável. Ela também foi usada brevemente por Katsuki Bakugo.

descricao:
Orcinus is the summation of the user's many orca-related abilities. They can do anything a regular orca can do, even on land.

Coupled with a large size, Orcinus grants the user enhanced strength and speed, especially in water. It also comes with the power to produce ultrasonic waves that can paralyze targets instantly. The waves are powerful enough to break apart large waves of ice.

Outburst has never been seen being used in action, but its functions have been described by Izuku Midoriya. According to him, this Quirk allows the user to force others around them to burst into laughter so intense that it dulls their motor skills and cognitive abilities. It is useful for incapacitating villains. The full extent of this Quirk's power, as well as its limitations, are unknown.

When activated, a blue aura appears around Ms. Joke. It is unclear whether or not Ms. Joke must say anything to make people laugh, or if the laughter is purely spontaneous.
Overclock was the Quirk used by Iwao Oguro, until it was stolen from him by All For One, who later gave it to Number 6.

Overhaul gives the user the ability to disassemble and then reassemble matter with their bare hands.

Once Kai takes a target apart, he has the option of either leaving it destroyed, restoring it to its original form, or shaping it into something new. This process happens instantly and is effective on living and non-living things alike. Kai just needs one finger to make contact with something for his Quirk to activate, with the choice of whether Overhaul should affect only one select part of his target, or its entirety being left solely to Kai's wishes, as shown when he blew off Mr. Compress' left arm.

Kai is capable of deconstructing matter and reconstructing it into shapes favorable to himself and hostile to his enemies. When activating Overhaul on an entire area, the deconstruction and reconstruction phases both happen extremely fast.

Overmodification can amplify the Quirk of an individual if they are compatible with the user. This boosts the base abilities of the affected Quirk and can even grant brand new ones to the user with enough contact.

The method of receiving modifications is through physical contact, where the activation of the Quirk is shown through the change of the user's hair color to black, and the sudden appearance of rose petals blooming. The recipient's eyes briefly dilate as a response from the exchange. The modifications are not a one-time effect and can be done multiple times, with seemingly no initial strain on the person receiving the modification. While the modifications can be unpredictable at first, they are generally powerful and can even make simple Quirks troublesome.

Pain Blocker makes the user unable to detect any pain, both inside and outside their body.

Gigantomachia is able to keep this Quirk active in conjunction with his original Endurance Quirk, contributing to his already extreme levels of strength and durability. This lets him easily withstand powerful attacks, while also allowing the giant to keep attacking without being halted by pain. An example of this is when he shrugged off being hit head-on by Dabi's Blueflames, which are far hotter than regular fire.

Combined with his immense size, hardened muscles, and ability to greatly conserve his energy and stamina, this Quirk adds to Gigantomachia's tremendous physicality, to the point where he can plow through entire cityscapes with groups of trained warriors and Pro Heroes attacking him without exhausting from fatigue.

With practice, the user can turn the pain blocking on and off.

The Quirk allows the user to flatten their body like papyrus.

Salaam is able to stretch and fold his arms, that is demonstrated while helping with Japan’s restoration.

Salaam can slip through narrow spaces and can also ride the wind to move at incredible speed.

Permeation grants the user the ability to phase their body through all matter.

The user can choose to make one part of themselves intangible or their entire body. This allows one to smoothly maneuver through obstacles and effortlessly evade incoming attacks. If this Quirk is deactivated while the user is phasing through the ground or another solid object, they will be instantly repelled to the surface due to the laws of physics not allowing their own body mass to overlap with any other preexisting mass.
Given the name, Physical Enhancement likely allowed the user to enhance their physical capabilities. When the user activates the Quirk, their body is enveloped in a green flame-like aura.
Plant allows the user to transform their body parts into plant structures. These structures have properties which can heal their allies.

The Quirk's proper function isn't entirely known, due to it only being shown under the effects of Trigger.

Mario's Quirk seemingly grows him to gigantic proportions, similar to Gigantification, while also turning his skin black (most likely due to Trigger) and growing an extra set of arms. It also seems to lower the user's intelligence to cause them to act like a child playing with action figures.

Pliabody allows the user to stretch and flatten their own body at will, granting them enhanced flexibility.

Pliabody is useful for rescue operations, allowing Tiger to get through narrow passages. In combat, it can be used to easily dodge blows and restrain opponents, like handcuffs and other restraint devices.

Pointer allowed the user to point in the direction of people, places and things that they were looking for. In order to use his Quirk, Compass Kid needed to spin in place before his limbs pointed toward what he needed to find.

Poison Gas allows the user to generate a toxic fog that make people feel sick when they breathe it. If Takeshi does not release it, then the poison gas begins to accumulate inside him. The gas is seen to be very potent, though this is probably due to years of accumulation without release.

Poltergeist allows the user to telekinetically manipulate objects and people close to them. 

Reiko displays great control over her Quirk, being able to move large swarms of objects in order to barrage a target.

Polygraph allows the user to judge the authenticity and genuineness of their target's words, telling them if they speak the truth or if they are lying. The condition for this Quirk's activation is direct physical contact with their target.

When Makoto activates her Quirk, green-yellow lightning slightly sparks from her hands and around anyone she's touching.

Pop Off allows the user to produce sticky spheres from their head that they can pluck painlessly. 

Once Minoru removes one of his spheres, a new one will grow in its place almost instantly. The spheres will adhere to any surface they come into contact with, except for Minoru himself. Water does not seem to affect the adhesion capabilities of the spheres.

Power grants its user the ability to build up tremendous raw power in their body, giving them incredible strength that's strong enough to smash through a reinforced concrete building.

Hood uses it in conjunction with other Quirks to overpower Endeavor and easily throw him through the top floors of a high-rise building.

was a Meta Ability given to Yoichi Shigaraki by All For One, who stole it from an unknown user.

This Meta Ability would fuse with Yoichi's own power, Quirk Bestowal, to become One For All.
This Quirk allows the user to grow and duplicate parts of their body all over themselves, giving them a multiplied increase in power depending on how many duplicates there are.

This Quirk grants the user an extra pair of arms.

The extra limbs allow Fourth Kind to handle several objects at once while also giving him an advantage in hand-to-hand combat, which he specializes in.
Queen Beam is the Quirk used by an unnamed female student from Masegaki Primary School.
is the Quirk used by Kuin Hachisuka, through Tamao Oguro, and Bee☆Pop, through Kazuho Haneyama.

Quirk Bestowal was the Quirk used by Yoichi Shigaraki.

After All For One forcibly transferred Power Stock to Yoichi, it merged with Quirk Bestowal, resulting in the creation of One For All.

Rabbit grants the user rabbit-like anatomy and abilities. The Quirk gives Rumi enhanced senses of hearing and smelling, as she was able to accurately pinpoint the location of a fight from far away.

Similarly to Frog, Rabbit grants Rumi functional rabbit features like long ears, large, strong legs and a fluffy tail. She also possesses a rabbit's survival instincts, which alerts her of any nearby danger.

Rabbit provides increased leg strength. Through it, Rumi can move around by bouncing and attack by stomping or kicking. One single ground stomp is capable of generating strong enough wind pressure to disperse even fire.
is a Quirk used by Tomura Shigaraki and All For One, who had originally stolen it from someone else.
is the primary Quirk of the EMP Bombers, as well as one of the Quirks possessed by Number 6.

Razor Sharp allows the user to produce large blades from their body.

Togaru's blades can come in a variety of shapes and sizes, and from any part of his body. These blades are strong enough to cut through metal pipes (which are commonly made up of steel or iron), and durable enough to withstand a point-blank explosion.

Reflect allows the user to absorb energy and send it back in the opposite direction. When something strikes them, a spiraling wave of energy forms from behind, and the same attack is rebound back at the opponent.

Flect can automatically use this Quirk to counter both physical and ranged attacks, making it very difficult to harm him. It also has a side-effect of making his skin glow blue, which turns into a white complexion once he is defeated.
was a stolen Quirk used by Tomura Shigaraki. It was destroyed when Tomura stole Cathleen Bate's New Order.

Rewind grants the user the ability to reverse a living being's body back to a previous state. It also gives the user a small, brown horn on the right side of their forehead, which grows larger when the Quirk is activated. The Quirk is the result of an extremely rare mutation, and bears no resemblance to any Quirk on either side of Eri's family's lineage.

When Rewind is activated, Eri's horn grows and glows brightly. Those that are in contact or in the vicinity of Eri at the moment of the activation start having their bodies rewound to previous physical states, undoing or bringing back injuries or modifications from the present or the past. She is capable of reverting people back to a point before they even existed, effectively erasing them from existence. Kai Chisaki even stated that this Quirk can rewind genetics, dubbing it a terrifying power.

With this Quirk, the user can protrude and retract a rifle gun from their right elbow.

Kaina bends her arm up so that her hand is to her shoulder and opens a cavity in her elbow, from which the rifle comes out of. The rifle seems to be made out of organic matter, using a semi-liquid sinew as a retractable bipod. She loads the bullets she makes with her moldable hair into a hole that opens up on her palm, which she uses to reload her ammo. According to Snipe, Rifle has a range of three kilometers.

As the rifle is made up of organic matter and doesn't require explosive (but noisy and flashy) combustion to propel bullets, it is a relatively stealthy weapon as an air rifle, using the propulsion provided by her Quirk's usage of bone and muscle sinew to propel the rounds, leaving behind no audible explosive crack nor muzzle flash from her rifle's barrel.
Although never properly described, the Quirk seemingly allows the user to generate rivet-like growths from their arm.
is a Quirk, that was stolen from an unknown person, used by All For One and later by Tomura Shigaraki.
Rocket Thrust allows the users to shoot their right fists at people at very high speeds.
Saber allows the user to transform portions of their body into sword-shaped appendages, which they can use offensively.

The Quirk gave the user the ability to transform their upper body into sand.

Sajin could manipulate this sand freely, allowing him to shape it into different forms.
Scalemail is a Quirk used by Shuichi Iguchi, given to him by All For One, who stole it from someone else.

Scales allows the user to form hard scales throughout their entire body, which they can either use as protective armor, or fire them off as projectiles. According to Hiryu's costume notes, growing scales requires collagen and calcium.

The generated scales resemble those of a reptile's. They are quite hard and sharp, hurting anyone who comes in contact with them. For the same reasons, the scales make for dangerous projectiles, with Hiryu being capable of launching them. The launched scales can cut through Vines and even damage solid metal structures.

Scanning allowed the user to search for and identify people's Quirks to some extent, as well to measure their level of power using a heat signature-like vision. The latter was displayed when Nine was able to detect Deku's deliberate power boost.
Scatter allows the user to split up and multiply projectiles while firing them, increasing the strength and radius of long-range attacks.
Search was the Quirk formerly used by Tomoko Shiretoko, until it was stolen from her by All For One, and later used by Tomura Shigaraki.
Self-Detonation, also known as Detonation, is the Quirk used by the Bombers, Number 6, and the Anonymous.

Serpentress grants the user a trio of living snakes as part of their hair, which are implied to be a part of their biology.

The snakes have excellent senses, which Uwabami can utilize in order to locate hidden enemies as well as missing disaster victims. Thus, she specializes in rescue missions.

It is unknown if the snakes have any sort of offensive purpose.

Shame allows the user to become more powerful as they become more embarrassed. Teruo activates his Quirk by removing all his clothes and exhibiting himself to become extremely embarrassed by the populace.

Shield allowed the user to manifest stone-like, hexagonal shields from their body that could be utilized both defensively and offensively.

The shields created by this Quirk were extremely sturdy and capable of enduring a multitude of offensive Quirks. They were formed from layers of rapidly multiplying hexagons which allowed Crust to choose the exact size of the shield he wished to utilize. Crust could also detach the shields from his body, allowing him to throw them as mid to long-range weapons or provide protection for his allies. The sides of the shields were extremely sharp, giving them offensive capabilities as well.

As described by Tomura Shigaraki, Shock Absorption gives the user the ability to reduce the effectiveness of physical blows by absorbing the shocks produced by them, allowing them to cancel out many attacks.
This Quirk allows its user to have four retractable jet boosters mounted on their upper back, which grants them speed-boosted flight.

This Quirk grants the user the ability to alter the size of objects that they come into contact with.

As seen during the Joint Training Battle, Yui can only activate this power by pressing five of her fingertips together.

When Yui uses it, the objects she uses her Quirk on glow pink.

Slice allows the user to move, harden, and sharpen their own hair. They are able to use their hair as blades as well as fire off individual strands of it like needles, with enough speed and strength to puncture and detonate fishing boats.

Kiruka can also use her hair for defensive purposes by using it as a shield or for parrying attacks as well as mobility by using large locks of it as stilts.

is the Quirk used by Koichi Haimawari.

After Koichi goes by the hero name "The Skycrawler", this Quirk is reclassified as .

Sloshed causes anyone who approaches the user to lose their sense of balance, falling into a state similar to inebriation. It's possible that the user is able to choose who is "sloshed" and who isn't, as Shin Nemoto seemed unaffected despite his close proximity to Deidoro, though this might be due to natural or built up resistance to loss of equilibrium. 

Those affected by Sloshed become unable to move and act properly. Deidoro can also hide himself from view to allow his Quirk to materialize while undetected. The inebriating effect may linger for a while even if Deidoro loses consciousness.

It's possible to fight against the effects of this Quirk, assuming one is used to similar feelings. Maintaining distance from Deidoro can also prevent Sloshed from working.

This Quirk allows the user to force other people to laugh uncontrollably for two hours. The user activates this Quirk by showing their teeth to the victim; it also works if the user's teeth are seen in a mirror or on video, as long as they are seen in real time.

This state of uncontrollable laughter completely incapacitates people, as they are barely able to move, let alone fight, as long as they are laughing. In some cases, the uncontrollable laughter can even cause the victim to lose control of their Quirk. Some people like Shoto Todoroki may resist the urge to laugh, but will still be incapacitated by the effects, or in a case like with Katsuki Bakugo, knock themselves unconscious.

Smoke allows the user to expel large amounts of pink smoke through the holes in their body, to generate a thick smoke screen to mask and hide their movement from enemies' line of sight. They can also use the antenna on their head to fire a thick layer of smoke directly at the enemy to distract them.

In addition to blocking the enemy's line of sight, the smoke also offers some short of advantage to the Robber Villain in close encounters because it causes irritation in the eyes of those who get too close to him.
was the Quirk used by En Tayutai and later inherited by Izuku Midoriya, before forcibly transferring it via blood transference to Tomura Shigaraki.

Snip Clip allows the user to cut through nearly anything that is placed between their index and middle fingers by making a scissor motion with them. It's powerful enough to easily cut through the limbs of solid steelworker exoskeletons, but it's obviously limited by the space between their fingers.

For bigger cuts, Monika can also slice almost anything between her legs.

Soccer supposedly allows the user to dribble a ball like a professional soccer player among large crowds of people without this preventing them from carrying out their acts of larceny. It also allows them to kick the ball with incredible power, turning it into a weapon. There are doubts about whether this should be considered a Quirk.

Softening allows the user to soften anything they touch, effectively turning solid objects semi-liquid.

Softening works on anything solid, such as ice, metal, or the ground, and it possesses great range. The softened objects become similar to mud or quicksand, trapping and sinking anything caught on it. To revert the effects of Softening, Juzo only needs to touch the softened object a second time.

Softening is extremely effective against enemies who rely on ground or building mobility, as those become unstable footholds for one to move through. A softened structure or spot might look normal at first glance, but will lose its apparent solidity once someone steps on it, meaning Softening works well for laying traps.

Solid Air allows the user to solidify air to form constructs such as walls and platforms through their breath.

Air walls do not fall to the ground once solidified and will stay afloat in midair even when another person hangs onto it. They're soundproof as well, making them effective against Quirks that rely on their user's voice, such as Anivoice or Brainwashing.

Somnambulist allowed the user to put targets to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from their skin.

Somnambulist was described as being more effective on males than on females, which gave Nemuri an obvious advantage against men. Regardless of that, anyone who breathed in enough of the aroma would fall into a deep slumber, making it difficult for opponents to confront Nemuri at close range.

In the anime, the mist that represented the Quirk's aroma took a lavender-purple color.
Soul manifests itself as Pino, a small, pink bird-like creature, and is always active. Pino is connected to the user's soul and her actions articulate their true thoughts and feelings.

Spatial Excursion allows the user to freely move objects and people in any space without being restricted by gravity.

When strengthened by Overmodification, the range of the effect and amount Kamile can control is greatly expanded, including being capable of manuevering the Gollini Family's entire giant mobile fortress. The effects are later deactivated when Kamile is knocked unconscious by Lemillion.
Spear Hand Missiles is the Quirk used by the unnamed students from the 3rd Planet From The Black Hole High School.
is a Quirk used by All For One, who stole it from his mother. It was passed to at least one other person in the past, and later inherited by Tomura Shigaraki.

Spike allows its user to make spikes protrude from their body. The spikes produced naturally appear to be roughly as long as its user's fingers, though it is unknown just how long they can extend to. Initially, the user only seems able to generate three spikes per hand or foot.

The spikes are cone-shaped, appearing to be metallic in makeup and are sharp to the point. Akin to claws, they can pop out, and then retract back between the knuckles of the user's hands. Additionally, they are also able to be released from the user's feet, presumably between their toes.

When under the effects of the Trigger drug, this Quirk is greatly amplified, as it gives this Quirk a porcupine-like physiology, with a large number of quills extruding from the users back, neck, upper arms, forearms, and head, becoming dramatically longer than the Quirk usually allows.

Spotted Seal is the summation of Selkie's many spotted seal-related abilities. He can do anything a regular spotted seal can do, even on land.

Spotted Seal grants its user enhanced strength and agility on land. It also grants them increased swimming speed and the ability hold their breath for prolonged periods of time and to dive as deep as fifteen hundred meters, as well as the ability to use echolocation underwater.
is a Quirk used by All For One, who stole it from an unknown user, and later Tomura Shigaraki.

Squirmy Fingers allows the user to precisely and flawlessly control their fingers, effectively manipulating any object with grace, ease, speed, precision and skill, as well as to bend them in any direction.

David has enhanced dexterity and puts this to use in the Hero Costumes he creates, though he described his Quirk as "barely useful" to his daughter Melissa when she was diagnosed as Quirkless.

By rubbing their body to build up electric charge, like the process to generate static electricity, the user of Static can generate electrical currents. The details of this ability are unclear, but it appears to be a relatively weak electrical charge.

Steel allows the user to transform their entire body into steel.

Steel makes Tetsutetsu's body virtually impenetrable; it is tough enough to protect Tetsutetsu from bullets, blades and tons of falling metal, as well as other lethal hazards. Naturally, it increases his physical strength to superhuman levels, too, allowing him to break through most obstacles. Tetsutetsu has said that he will gain longer and stronger use of his Quirk depending on the level of iron that is in his diet. It is unknown if this refers to foods that have iron in them or if he has to eat the actual metal itself.

Steel can protect Tetsutetsu from extreme temperatures. Ice and cold have no effect on his skin when Steel is activated, making Tetsutetsu immune to natural freezing such as Shoto Todoroki's.

Stiffening gives the user the ability to harden anything they touch.

By kneading objects together with both his hands, Shikkui can harden something like rubber balls to be as tough as concrete, to the point where they can break through solid rock if thrown with enough force.

Stiffening doesn't work on living beings. The hardened objects are also not acid-proof and can get stuck to viscous substances.

Stock allows the user to absorb attacks and store them up to release whenever they want.

To do this, Garvey must "devour" the enemy's attack, and once this is done, a lump grows in his back. When he needs it in battle, the lump detaches from his back and floats until it ends up in front of his face, releasing the attack that was stored there.

This Quirk gives its user the ability to store objects, even living, biological creatures, inside their body, carrying them around and able to release them at will.

Hood used it to store multiple white Nomu within his body and released them as reinforcements to distract the interfering Pro Heroes as he battled Endeavor. Hood was able to store at least nine Nomu within his body, although it's unknown if this is his limit.

Stress grants the user the ability to convert stress, anger, dread, and frustration into raw power. This raw power is capable of increasing their strength, resilience, and size.

 
The higher the degree of stress, the larger and tougher the user can make parts of their body. The sheer power gained from this ability is represented by black markings that spread to the enhanced areas of the user's body.

Any limb can be enhanced at will, or the user's entire body can be improved all at once. A single finger was enough to destroy a Double of Twice and a single hulking arm annihilated several League of Villains clones while causing a massive shockwave with a single swing.

Rikiya can adjust the percentage of "Liberation" in his Meta Ability as a measure for his overall enhancements.

Strongarm allows the user to rotate and move their shoulders at great speed and power, giving them extremely fast and strong punches.

Kendo is able to throw a huge flurry of punches that are incredibly quick, and immensely powerful. He was also able to whittle away at Fat Gum, a Pro Hero with a defensive Quirk, using the pure shock from his punches.

Sugar Rush allows the user to multiply their strength five-fold for three minutes for every ten grams of sugar they ingest.

Rikido must consume the required sugar quantities for his Quirk to be activated in the first place. This can be achieved by eating any food items that carry enough sugar content, such as most sweets, soft drinks or even raw, granulated sugar. Once this condition is met, Rikido is able to convert the absorbed sugar into raw strength, with his body slightly bulking up as a result.

Nothing is known about the exact functions of this Quirk. However, as its name suggests, this Quirk seems capable of creating huge explosions that surround the user and destroy their surroundings.

Endeavor's Hellflame Quirk was described as the worst match-up against this Quirk, which implies that it can be set off from outside sources as well as its user's will.

It is also implied that this Quirk can kill its own user.

, also known as Hyper-Regeneration or simply , is the Quirk used by Number 6 and the Multi-Armed Bomber, Upper-Tier Nomu such as the U.S.J. Nomu and the Eyeless Hosu Nomu, the High-End Nomu such as Hood and Woman, the Near High-End Nomu, and Tomura Shigaraki.
Swan grants the user two large, white, swan-like wings on their back. They can achieve flight but are not strong enough to do so without them stripping off their clothes first.

Sword Kill allows the user to create flexible swords from their arms and shoulders, that fold in and out like an accordion.

When their Quirk is boosted by Trigger, the Serpenters can produce up to six swords, including from their mouths, and their faces become more sinister and snake-like.

Tail grants the user a prehensile appendage that extends from their lower posterior.

Mashirao's tail is very bulky, being longer and wider than any of his regular human limbs. Its tip contains a tuft of blonde hair, reflecting Mashirao's normal hair color.

Tail effectively functions as a third limb. It's strong enough to break objects made of metal, capture enemies and support Mashirao's own weight. Mashirao has been shown using his tail hairs to point in a direction akin to the finger of a hand, but it is unconfirmed if he could use them in more complex operations like a real hand.

As part of his training, Mashirao continuously used his tail to attack a body-hardened Eijiro Kirishima, and with each hit, the strength and durability of Mashirao's Tail increased.
This Quirk turns the user's head and their entire upper body into the locomotive of a steam-powered train.

Tape allows the user to eject adhesive tape from openings located on both of their elbows.

Hanta's elbows look and function like tape dispensers, from where he can fire lengths of tape that stick to anything he aims at. The amount of tape Hanta is able to generate in a single instance isn't unlimited, but it's still plentiful enough for him to successfully utilize for various offensive, defensive and movement purposes, making his Quirk surprisingly versatile.

The tape is strong enough to immobilize opponents, hold large structures together and support Hanta's own weight. Once a strand of tape is released from Hanta's elbows, he has the choice of either cutting it off with his hands to allow new strands to be fired or leaving it intact for him to move around whatever he caught.

Telekinesis allows the user to move inanimate objects as they please.

When strengthened by Overmodification, the amount of objects Ugo can control at once significantly increases.

Telepath grants the user telepathy, to the point where they have the ability to communicate with anyone through thought. They can instruct and send messages to multiple people at once. The range of Shino's abilities is unknown, but it was enough to reach everyone inside The Beast's Forest at once. Telepath is only one-way communication, so its user cannot hear their targets' thoughts or receive responses.

When Shino is fighting against an enemy, she can use her telepathy to send messages directly to her foe's mind with the intention of distracting them. This throws them off, causing them to lower their guard against Shino’s next attack.

Teleportation allows the user to move themselves and any material or living thing they are touching to wherever they wish, as long as that somewhere is within their line of vision and can be clearly seen.

When strengthened by Overmodification, Gil's activation speed increases dramatically.

Telescopic allows the user to retract their own body parts into themselves, similar to how a turtle can retract itself into its shell.

Telescopic is very quick to activate, allowing the user to retract into themselves on short notice to evade projectiles traveling at a high velocity. Unretracting, however, is not an instantaneous process and requires a few seconds to accomplish.

Tatami's main use for this Quirk is for defense and evasion. She was able to evade Fumikage's Piercing Twilight Claws with ease, even though she was caught off guard.

Tidal Bore allows the user to produce a large amount of water from their mouth.

Big Red Dot boasts enough strength to easily lift up a Trigger Bomb using the Quirk. When he sees his favorite food, he causes a flood around him.
Toho gives the user the attributes of a kaiju; in addition to their reptile-like appearance, they are very large and very strong.

The Quirk allows the user to transform their tongue into a tank cannon that can extend out of their mouth when opened. It has been shown to be able to shoot out rock-like projectiles.

It is currently unknown whether they have to ingest something in order to fire these, or if they produce their own ammunition.

The Quirk apparently allows the user to manifest limbs with ingrown tools and weapons, including several fully functional chainsaws, a claw hammer, and a drill. The Chainsaw Nomu was also capable of retracting the limbs back to its body.
Traject allows the user to manipulate the trajectory of anything that passes through their bandages.

With this Quirk, the user could transform into another person's appearance after consuming some of their blood.

Transform gave the user the full ability to copy a perfect image of another individual, including tiny details. They were even able to replicate the voice of the person they transformed into.

The amount of time the user could utilize a particular transformation was proportionate to the amount of blood that they had consumed. One cup of blood equated to roughly one day's worth of being able to be transformed into that person. If the blood of multiple people had been ingested, then the Quirk user was able to transform into any of them, even being able to switch appearances without having to return to their original shape between transformations.
is one of the Quirks used by Hood, as well as All For One, who stole it from an unknown person.
Trap Flex allows the user to flex their trapezius muscle to extreme degrees, allowing them to cover their whole head with their shoulders. The flexing gives them a fair amount of speed and strength.

Tree Frog grants its user an extended tongue, which curls inward when she sticks it out.

Tamao's tongue is only slightly longer than normal, however, and appears to be much more limited than Quirks with similar tongue-extending effects like Tsuyu Asui's Frog.

Additionally, Tamao has webbed fingers and a general tadpole-like appearance, though it's unclear what parts of these are the results of Tree Frog specifically.
Tripod grants its user a third leg, placed between their other two. This third leg acts as one would expect, including allowing the user to stabilize themselves on otherwise unstable terrain.

Twin Impact allows the user to, at the site of any initial impact, create a second impact remotely and at their discretion that will be many times stronger than the initial one.

The user can use this to create a propulsion force, such as to deliver an impact to an object, send it flying at opponents, or send possible weapons away.

As seen when Neito Monoma Copied this Quirk during the Joint Training Battle, it can additionally be used on people to create a second, harsher strike on someone in the same place they were initially hit, even if said hit was a mere grazing swipe.

Vibrate gives the user the ability to generate vibrations, or shockwaves, which can travel through virtually any medium. Yo most notably uses this ability to shake things he touches with his hands.

Vibrate allows Yo to control the speed and strength of his vibrations, including how long the intervals are between tremors. Vibrating most objects vigorously will cause them to shatter and break. When used on the ground, Vibrate can create small controlled earthquakes.

Due to the Vibrate's after-effects, this Quirk can grant the user resistance to vibrations, such as hypersonic attacks.
Vibration Detection is an unnamed Quirk used by All For One, who stole it from an unknown person.

Vines grants the user controllable, thorny vines in place of regular hair. The vines can be manipulated for various purposes, such as binding foes, snatching objects and creating defensive barriers. They can also be cut off from the head at will, including being tough enough to dig through concrete.

Because her vines don't conduct electricity, Ibara has a natural advantage against Electrification and other electrical-based Quirks. Ibara's thorns also appear to be sharp enough to cause abrasion, as seen by the cuts sustained by Denki and Eijiro during the Joint Training Battle, Tetsutetsu needing to Steel his arm under her head while carrying her during the Vanguard Action Squad Invasion, and her pretending to be concerned about a scratch on Yui's back caused by her thorns.
Viral Cosmos is the Quirk used by an unnamed student from Masegaki Primary School.

Voice allows the user to increase the volume of their voice, giving them the ability to create loud, high-pitched sounds.

The sound that comes from Hizashi's mouth can reach extremely high levels, enough to incapacitate people by disrupting their eardrums (which may cause bleeding). The loud noise will also drown out other sound-based Quirks, giving him an advantage against those Quirk types in battle.

Voyance allows the user to see through any object within view, except for living organisms.

When Clair activates her Quirk, she peers through a hole formed by her fingers to limit her field of vision, which makes her power last longer.

She uses her Quirk to assist the Otheon team in tracking down Humarise's Trigger Bombs.

Using this Quirk, the user can create and manipulate a dark fog that acts as a portal.

When the user produces a mass of the dark fog, it transports anything it comes in contact with to a nearby location. Kurogiri can even shroud himself with the black mist to hide his true body and personally transport anything out of himself. Should a Warp Gate close while someone is stuck halfway through, the person will be cut in half.

Warp Gate is an artificial Quirk, created from a fusion of several different Quirks with Cloud acting as the base Quirk.

Warp Gate's mist is predominantly purple and black, with it making up most of Kurogiri's body. However, when his personality as Oboro Shirakumo resurfaced, the Warp Gate portals had streaks of light blue mixed in from Oboro's Cloud.

This Quirk allows the user to produce a black ooze-like liquid from other people's mouths. The black liquid then envelops the person's entire body and acts as a warping portal, vanishing along with the target before reappearing at a different location. It's possible to create separate portals to warp multiple people all at once. The black liquid apparently has a horrid smell.

Warping utilizes specific people as a destination, unlike Warp Gate, which uses coordinates.

The Quirk allows the user to control and manipulate water. Hanzo uses his abilities to execute a plethora of water-based attacks, such as forming water into sharp claws, strong enough to slash through a boat, and sending powerful torrents of water towards his opponent.
Water Gun allows the user to shoot a stream of water from their hands.

The Quirk allows the user to create water from the hose spigots they have in place of hands. Backdraft has a great level of control over the water, being able to change the form of the water to shape it into a barricade rail with 'X' shaped warning symbols or a hand.

Wave Motion grants the user the ability to convert their vitality into energy that they can discharge as blast waves.

Upon release, the energy converted from their stamina is unleashed as golden energy that travels in the form of a spiral. The amount of vitality converted can be adjusted by Nejire at will.

Weather Manipulation allowed its user to freely manipulate all types of weather. Nine had shown he was capable of creating large storm clouds that enveloped entire islands, summon lightning bolts, and even create giant tornadoes. This Quirk also allowed him to manipulate wind and granted him flight. The storms created from this Quirk were strong enough to severely damage an entire island.

Weld allows the user to merge things both organic and inorganic at a subatomic level.

When Yosetsu activates his Quirk, the two objects he's making contact with will become physically connected. This extends to Yosetsu's own body as well, as he is capable of melding himself with objects or people as well. Yosetsu can reverse the effects of Weld if he needs to.
Whale allows the user to transform parts of or their whole body into that of a sperm whale. While in full whale form, this Quirk allows Curator to shoot streams of water from his mouth.

Whirlwind grants the user the ability to control the air around them.

Inasa is able to manipulate gusts of wind with little to no movement from his body at all, letting him create strong gales and small tornadoes that he has full mastery over. Great winds may be used to propel Inasa, the people around him, and different objects all at the same time.

Whiteline allows the user to manipulate and control any lane lines painted on the road.

Ending uses his Quirk like tentacles to entangle and immobilize his target, as well as throw objects, such as cars, through the air. The base power of the Quirk alone is not known since Ending was only shown using it while under the effects of Trigger.

Whole-Body Lens allows the user to produce camera-like lenses anywhere on their body to take pictures. They can also print any pictures their body cameras have captured out of their chest whenever they want. It is implied that Taneo can hold onto these pictures internally for as long as he wants.
Wing is an unnamed Quirk used by a Near High-End Nomu and later Tomura Shigaraki.
Wooden Swords From His Hands allows the user to generate wooden swords from their wrist.

Zero Gravity allows the user to remove the effects of gravity from solid things upon touching them with the pads on their fingertips.

The targets lose their gravitational pull the moment Ochaco makes contact with them, effectively making them weightless. Through Zero Gravity, Ochaco can make anything solid float in mid-air as long as they are within the weight limit of her Quirk, which is around three tons. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together.

As part of her training, Ochaco put herself into plastic sphere that would tumble down a mountain, all in effort to get her inner ear canals used to zero gravity and reduce nausea, all while increasing how much weight she can lift.

During the Final War, Ochaco underwent an Awakening after being grievously stabbed by Himiko Toga while refusing to back down.

Zombie Virus allows the user to release a pinkish gas that, when inhaled, temporarily transforms victims into zombies. Infected individuals gain the endurance of a zombie, enhanced strength, and the ability to transmit the virus through bites. If a Quirk user is exposed to the gas, their ability to control their powers is severely compromised; they can only use their powers randomly while in a zombie state. Their cognitive function is reduced to zero, leading them to focus solely on pursuing and biting those who are uninfected. However, they retain some aspects of their personality. In addition, they exhibit bluish-gray skin, sunken eyes, and a characteristic moan.

This Quirk grants the user eyesight that can zoom far away, allowing them to clearly see distant people and objects.

By focusing her eyes into a particular spot, Mei is capable of seeing up to 5 kilometers. Her eyes also feature unique crosshair-shaped irises, which might be a physical feature of the Quirk.

Mei mostly uses her Quirk to search for people that might be of her interest, like potential investors.
